purpose: Preserve the reproducibility boundary for the T07 archived-production-score validation without committing the private sampling key.

scorer.note: The committed T07 result records a dirty historical working tree. Therefore the historical source_git_sha alone is not a claim of bit-for-bit reconstruction of the executed working tree. The current reviewed scorer is pinned separately by commit and SHA-256.

private_sampling_key.required_action_when_recovered: COMPLETED: the exact recovered private file was verified against the frozen 300-item consensus, public sampling authority, and T07 point estimates; only its SHA-256 is recorded in Git and the private file remains uncommitted.

judge_model_provenance.interpretation: T07 validates archived production judge scores against adjudicated human gold. It is not claimed to be a fresh bit-for-bit rerun of a revision-pinned judge model.
